reason: The README describes a local RAG plugin that indexes project text files and provides TF-IDF keyword search to retrieve relevant context for an agent, without external APIs or embedding models.

summaries.zh: 一个在本地索引项目文档、代码和配置文件，并通过 TF-IDF 关键词搜索为智能体提供相关上下文的 RAG 插件。
summaries.en: A local RAG plugin that indexes project documents, code, and configuration files and uses TF-IDF keyword search to provide relevant context to an agent.

capabilities: Reads and indexes specified local text files
Provides local TF-IDF keyword search over indexed content
Injects index statistics into the agent system prompt
